newsitem.title: UK: Turkey seeks 100,000 t gas oil in late Nov - trade.
newsitem.headline: Turkey seeks 100,000 t gas oil in late Nov - trade.

text.p: Turkey's state oil company Tupras issued a tender to buy 100,000 tonnes of gas oil for delivery in the second half of November, traders said on Wednesday.
It follows a purchase of 125,000 tonnes for delivery in the first half of the month.
The latest tender calls for four cargoes of 0.5 percent sulphur gas oil for delivery on Nov 15-18, 20-22, 25-27 and Nov 30-Dec 2. The delivery ports include Izmir, Izmit, Samsun and Trabzon.
The tender closes at 1600 hours Turkish time on November 7 and offers must remain valid until 1700 hours local time on November 8.
